newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Hydro Magnesium announces price cuts.
newsitem.headline: Hydro Magnesium announces price cuts.

text.p: Hydro Magnesium, a Brussels-based division of Norsk Hydro, announced on Wednesday changes to the structure of its European and North American magnesium prices. The changes are as follows (old price in brackets)-
European Producer Price pure magnesium: 5.40 Dm/Kg (5.95)
European Producer Price alloy magnesium: 5.40 Dm/Kg (5.55)
In a statement, Hydro Magnesium said the change to the pure price reflected the results of negotiations for first quarter 1997 deliveries.
Prices were now 22 percent lower than at the beginning of 1996 and, at current exchange rates, around 14 percent below the prevailing U.S. price of $1.80 a pound, it noted.

"U.S. producers are now selling in Europe at prices close to the minimum established by the European Commission for Russian and Ukrainian magnesium, and well below their transaction levels in the U.S.," the company said.
"The alloy magnesium price continues to display relative stability not available from competing metals. In inflation adjusted terms, today's price is lower than in 1992," it said.
In November 1992 European magnesium alloy was at 5.00 marks a kilo, it noted.
